# Harbor Helpdesk

> Harbor Helpdesk is an open source (AGPL-3.0) helpdesk by Archboard. It turns support inboxes into tickets that people and AI agents work together, through the web app, a versioned JSON API and a built-in MCP server.

- Self-host it free with Docker or on a Debian/Ubuntu VM. It needs PHP, PostgreSQL, Redis and Reverb.
- Or use Harbor Cloud, hosted by Archboard, with each workspace on its own subdomain of harbor.help.
- Mailboxes: Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP/SMTP or a hosted address.
- Features: desks with manual, round robin or load-balanced assignment; SLA policies with business hours; automations and macros; a customer portal with satisfaction ratings; reports and exports; webhooks; passkeys and an audit log.
- AI agents connect over MCP at https://<workspace>.harbor.help/mcp with OAuth, scoped to one workspace, and use the same actions and permissions as people.
